lines.en: We got to the hotel tired and wet, but very happy.

questions.question: When did they leave Teresópolis?
questions.explanation: “Saímos de Teresópolis às sete horas da manhã.”

questions.question: What was the path like?
questions.explanation: “O caminho era difícil”.

questions.question: Where did they have lunch?
choices: At the top of the mountain.
questions.explanation: “comemos sanduíches perto de uma cachoeira”.

questions.question: How did they feel when they got back?
questions.explanation: “Chegamos ao hotel cansados e molhados, mas muito felizes.”

gloss.en: did; made (fazer); fazer uma trilha: to go on a hike
Serra dos Órgãos (mountain range near Rio)
top; lá de cima: from up there

lines.pt: Para ir à Ilha Grande, a gente pegou um barco em Angra dos Reis.
lines.en: To get to Ilha Grande, we took a boat in Angra dos Reis.

lines.pt: A viagem durou uma hora e meia.
lines.en: The crossing took an hour and a half.

lines.pt: Na ilha não tem carros, então todo mundo anda a pé.
lines.en: There are no cars on the island, so everyone walks.

lines.pt: A gente ficou numa pousada simples, mas muito limpa.
lines.en: We stayed in a simple but very clean guesthouse.

lines.pt: Nadamos todos os dias em praias quase vazias.
lines.en: We swam every day at almost empty beaches.

lines.pt: No último dia, o mar estava agitado e o barco saiu com atraso.
lines.en: On the last day, the sea was rough and the boat left late.

questions.question: How long was the boat crossing?
questions.explanation: “A viagem durou uma hora e meia.”

questions.question: How do people get around on the island?
questions.explanation: “Na ilha não tem carros, então todo mundo anda a pé.”

questions.question: What was the guesthouse like?
questions.explanation: “uma pousada simples, mas muito limpa”.

questions.question: What happened on the last day?
questions.explanation: “o barco saiu com atraso”.

gloss.en: Ilha Grande (island off the Rio coast)
Angra dos Reis (coastal town in Rio de Janeiro state)
